page.notes: Italic type in the running text (for example the Latin of the notes and some words) is not marked, as its extent is not certain. The Greek words "κατάσεως" and the Greek after "Aut" are read with doubt; the word after "Conclusio absoluitur,aut" is too faint to read. The margin notes are printed with a hyphen at the line end ("Narratio-", "Propofitio-", "Conclusio-"); the word "Confirmatio" has none. The text "Pars quinta" was printed in a larger space; no printing errors were corrected. Note "Conclusio" sits beside the line "ma Conclusio" in the printed page.
